title: Grouping or Ordering? Coverage-Aware Sequential Federated Learning under Label Skew - code and results
description: Source code, prespecified analysis plans, per-run results (JSON) and generated manuscript tables and figures for the study 'Grouping or Ordering? Coverage-Aware Sequential Federated Learning under Label Skew' (revised FedDAC study). Includes the DAC grouping rule (Distribution-Aware Coverage), the coverage-aware chain order (FedDAC-Order), random, label-balanced and FedSeq grouping, IFCA, CFL, FedAvg, FedProx and PP-CFL, coverage metrics for groupings, record-level DP-SGD with a declared client capacity and RDP accounting, and label-distribution and membership inference attacks (loss attack, offline LiRA) on CIFAR-10 and MNIST. Version 2.0.0 contains the 673 runs of the revision protocol (partitions without duplicated examples, validation-based tuning, deterministic kernels, paired seeds). The v1.0.0 results and models of the earlier protocol are retained for the separately reported ResNet-18 results.
